title: Gemma 4 26B-A4B via Ollama (default tag)
slug_note: The MoE Gemma 4 in one command; 3.8B active parameters keep decode fast on a 24 GB card.

variation.quant_detail: Ollama's default `gemma4:26b` tag, 4-bit class; the tag page lists 16GB - 19GB and does not name the exact quant
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama ps` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-25)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): 31.0 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (262,144 tokens)). Earlier estimate: Estimate from the tag size (16GB - 19GB) plus KV headroom at Ollama's default context. Not measured.

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; Ollama 0.40.10 with its own default context on the 128 GB Spark (262,144 tokens)

caveats: Ollama's default context is small; raise num_ctx for long documents or coding agents.

Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-25): `ollama run gemma4:26b` answered after 26.0 s from a cold start (model files read from disk); 31.0 GiB resident. Ollama 0.40.10 on the 128 GB Spark picked a 262,144-token default context by itself, so memory is weights plus that KV. Set num_ctx lower to save memory.
